PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Limits the run time and memory use of programmable blocks to protect sim speed
PluginData.Description:
Tracks the real run time of every programmable block and punishes the ones over the limits, to protect sim speed.
Limits apply per block and to all of a player's blocks combined. Privileged players can have their own limits. Blocks over the limits are warned, then turned off, damaged or destroyed, and scripts can be told to shut down gracefully first. Under load, runs can be deferred instead.
Configure it in Quasar under Server plugins.
Player commands: !PBLimiter Limits, !PBLimiter MyStats, !PBLimiter Runtimes, !PBLimiter About. Admin commands: !PBLimiter GetReport, !PBLimiter Enable, !PBLimiter Disable, !PBLimiter requestpbshutdown and more, see !PBLimiter help.
Also available as a Torch plugin, both builds share the same code.
